title: Jonah Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on Jonah 2: the prayer from the fish's belly - the waves that passed over him, the weeds around his head, and salvation that belongs to Yahweh.

questions.text: From where did Jonah pray to Yahweh his God?
questions.explanation: Jonah prayed to Yahweh, his God, out of the fish's belly.

questions.text: Out of the belly of what does Jonah say he cried?
questions.explanation: He says he called to Yahweh because of his affliction and cried out of the belly of Sheol, and Yahweh heard his voice.

questions.text: What does Jonah say passed over him?
questions.explanation: He says the flood was all around him and that all Yahweh's waves and billows passed over him.

answers.text: A great wind out of the east
The shadow of death and the pit
All of Yahweh's waves and billows

questions.text: What did Jonah say he would do, though he had been banished from Yahweh's sight?
questions.explanation: He said he had been banished from Yahweh's sight, yet he would look again toward his holy temple.

answers.text: Go down to the depths of the sea
Look again toward his holy temple
Turn back to the ship at Joppa
Stay silent for the rest of his life

questions.text: What was wrapped around Jonah's head in the deep?
questions.explanation: The waters surrounded him, the deep was around him, and the weeds were wrapped around his head.

questions.text: From where does Jonah say Yahweh brought up his life?
questions.explanation: He went down to the bottoms of the mountains and the earth barred him in, yet Yahweh his God brought up his life from the pit.

questions.text: What did Jonah do when his soul fainted within him?
questions.explanation: When his soul fainted within him he remembered Yahweh, and his prayer came in to Yahweh's holy temple.

questions.text: What does verse 8 say about those who regard lying vanities?
questions.explanation: Those who regard lying vanities forsake their own mercy.

answers.text: They are heard in the end
They go down to the sea

questions.text: To whom does Jonah say salvation belongs?
questions.explanation: He promises to sacrifice with the voice of thanksgiving and to pay what he has vowed, and says that salvation belongs to Yahweh.

questions.text: What happened after Yahweh spoke to the fish?
questions.explanation: Yahweh spoke to the fish, and it vomited out Jonah on the dry land.

answers.text: It vomited Jonah out on the dry land
It carried Jonah on to Nineveh
It went down into the depths
